directions.title: AL Signature
directions.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Create a NEW premium logo concept board for "AVANTIX LABS", a company building websites, business automation, booking systems and AI agents, with ambitions to grow into software products. Correct spelling: AVANTIX has seven letters A V A N T I X. LABS has four letters L A B S. Absolutely no R in the name. The selected visual world is Sculpted Ivory: warm ivory #F3F0E8, espresso #191814, brushed bronze #8A4B2A and limestone #E4DED2. Refined, modern, intelligent craftsmanship. This is an additional logo option, not a website design.
Landscape 16:10 presentation with a calm disciplined grid. Upper 60%: large flat espresso logo + wordmark on plain warm ivory, exceptionally crisp clean edges, generous negative space. Lower 40%: three quiet aligned supporting panels: identical logo reversed ivory on espresso; identical logo subtly embossed in brushed bronze on warm stone; an isolated flat symbol with a small favicon application. All versions preserve precisely the same mark geometry and lettering. Keep primary artwork flat, high contrast and usable in a single color. Only the bronze application has 3D relief and tactile studio lighting. Wordmark hierarchy: AVANTIX large, LABS smaller and clearly legible underneath in restrained spaced capitals. Immaculate optical kerning. No tagline, no URL, no fake trademarks, no explanatory paragraphs. No existing real-world logos, no shields, crowns, lightning, AI brains, circuitry, sparkles, rainbow gradients, fake dense UI or ornamental luxury crests. Make a professional distinct logo, not a generic font letter on a business card. DIRECTION 05: AL SIGNATURE. Design a clever compact bespoke monogram combining A for AVANTIX and L for LABS into ONE coherent serif symbol. Use a crisp elevated A structure and a measured L foot extending from its right pier, with a deliberate negative-space structural slot showing the join. It should read as AL upon a second look, without clutter or redundant strokes. A subtle architectural ligature rather than overlapping two stock font letters. Moderate stroke contrast so it scales well. No AX shape and no duplicated A icon from previous designs. Pair the new AL mark with a refined medium-weight uppercase editorial serif AVANTIX wordmark and small understated sans LABS. Confident quiet luxury with engineering precision. Main composition horizontal, icon left and wordmark right. Bronze application can emphasize the elegant structural foot.

Preserve lowercase in all applications, including the bronze embossing. No detached X symbol in this option.
